objectives.label: Ask for a specific book
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for a book with 'Ali imate to knjigo?' / 'Rad bi to knjigo.'

objectives.label: Decide to reserve or not
objectives.descriptorEN: Choose yes ('Da, prosim.') or no ('Ne, hvala. Pridem drugič.').

objectives.label: Give your name
objectives.descriptorEN: Give your name with 'Ime mi je ___.' (dative).

objectives.label: Ask when it'll be ready
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask availability with 'Kdaj bo na voljo?'

n1.speaker: npc
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan, izvolite?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ali imate to knjigo?
c1a.en: Hello. Do you have this book?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi to knjigo, prosim.
c1b.en: Hello. I'd like this book, please.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Trenutek, preverim... Žal je trenutno ni. Želite, da vam jo rezerviram?
n2.en: One moment, I'll check... Unfortunately it's not here right now. Would you like me to reserve it for you?
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Trenutek, preverim... Žal je trenutno ni. Želite, da vam jo rezerviram?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.en: No, thanks. I'll come another time.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: V redu. Kako vam je ime?
n3.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] V redu. Kako vam je ime?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Hvala. Ko bo knjiga tu, vas pokličemo.
n4.en: Thanks. When the book is here, we'll call you.
n4.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Hvala. Ko bo knjiga tu, vas pokličemo.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Predvidoma čez teden dni.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] V redu, nasvidenje.
